description:
Is there anything worse than being a cop in prison? Try being a corrupt cop in prison.
In this video, we break down some of the wildest true stories of dirty cops who traded their badges for prison uniforms, and came face to face with the very system they once abused.

From NYPD’s infamous “Mafia Cops” Stephen Caracappa and Louis Eppolito, to Chicago torture commander Jon Burge, London blackmailer Rodney Whitchelo, and corrupt drug-running cop Michael Dowd. These men didn’t just cross the line, they erased it.

But prison has its own rules, and for corrupt cops behind bars, karma doesn’t knock politely.

Watch until the end to see who survived, and who didn’t.

00:11 - Stephen Caracappa & Louis Eppolito
